title: 第7章 妖族的修炼之法第8章 结出妖丹
content_zh:
张楚仔细研究了两本书册。
《万妖谱》类似于妖类的家族谱，上面记录了很多妖类，或者普通动物的起源。
例如兔妖，上面就有记录。
在洪荒纪，曾经出过一只特别的兔子，名为太阴玉兔。
那兔子跟随过一个强大的女人，女人甚至主掌过传说中的月宫，那是兔子一脉的最强始祖。
凡兔类，大多拥有太阴玉兔的一丝血脉。
还有很多物种，都能跟洪荒纪的某些恐怖生灵联系起来。
洪荒纪指的是上个时代，距今已经万年。
而这个时代，则被称之为春秋纪。
张楚感觉，这《万妖谱》对小村来说，应该没啥用。
但对妖类来说，似乎很重要，被那个兔妖贴身保存，用金线口袋封着，看上去很珍贵。
还有一本小册子，名为《大妖功》，名字很普通，里面是一些妖类的修炼秘法。
这部功法，张楚十分上心，这几天，他已经研读了三遍。
张楚觉得，村里几个青壮，单单肉身力量已经快要抵达了极限，再想变强，就需要走上修炼之路了。
“不知道妖族的功法，人类能不能修炼，是时候做出决定了。”张楚心中想道。
这天，童青山再次服用了一碗妖凝膏之后，找到了张楚。
“先生，我感觉，我的肉身力量已经到了极限，再服用妖凝膏，已经没用了。”童青山说道。
张楚点头：“知道了，今天，把所有人召集起来，开个会吧。”
很快，小村内所有人都聚集在了老枣树前。
这一次，老村长十分郑重，取出珍藏的一些猴儿酒，奉献给了老枣树。

张楚和老村长一起坐在正中央，村民们围在一旁。
这时候老村长说道：“这段时间，无论是猎人队，还是孩子们，都发生了天翻地覆的变化。”
“还是先生给的妖凝膏好！”有人急忙说道。
“没错，幸亏先生！”
这不是奉承，而是发自内心的感激。
老村长微微点头：“但这件事，必须保密，无论是妖凝膏，还是那三个大妖的事，都给我烂在肚子里，无论谁问，都不能说。”
“否则，外来人，可能会给我们带来灾难。”
老村长刚说完，一个十四五岁的少年人就喊道：“怕什么？如果有坏人再来，我们的枣树神一下，就能把敌人打死。”
还有几个孩子兴奋的点头，见识了老枣树的威能之后，很多孩子已经把老枣树视作无敌的神，一点都不把外来人放在心中。
老村长却摇头：“不能什么都依靠枣树神，在妖墟，守护神是有规矩的。”
“如果外来人杀我们，不伤守护神，守护神不能动手。”
“这一次枣树神出手，是因为那三个女妖不知天高地厚，想对枣树神动手，但如果她们的宗门来寻仇，那就麻烦了。”
众人一听，顿时有些心慌。
同时大家想到，那三个女妖进村的时候，就算语言颇有冒犯，枣树神都没有主动进攻。
也就是说，村民和妖之间的争斗，枣树神很可能真的不会出手。
此刻，老村长继续教育道：“所以，千万要记住，这些事情，不能说出去，否则，有大祸。”
众人急忙点头。
接下来，老村长看向了张楚，对张楚点点头。
张楚于是站了起来，开口道：“想要在妖墟更好的活下去，保守秘密终究是下策。如果我们拥有保护自己的力量，哪里还用保守秘密？”
这一刻，所有人都安静下来，每个人都静心屏气，眼睛瞪的滚儿圆，心情激动。

因为，张楚最近翻看那些书册，根本瞒不住村里人。
他们早就私下里传开了，张楚可能会教大家修炼功法。
content_en:
Zhang Chu studied the two books carefully.
"Ten Thousand Demons Genealogy" is similar to the family tree of demons, which records the origins of many demons or ordinary animals.
For example, the rabbit demon has records on it.
In the prehistoric era, there once appeared a special rabbit named Taiyin Jade Rabbit.
That rabbit once followed a powerful woman, who even controlled the legendary Moon Palace. She was the strongest ancestor of the rabbit lineage.
Most rabbits have a trace of the blood of the Taiyin Jade Rabbit.
There are many species that can be linked to some terrifying creatures from the prehistoric period.
The prehistoric era refers to the previous era, which has been thousands of years ago.
This era is called the Spring and Autumn Period.
Zhang Chu feels that this "Ten Thousand Demons Spectrum" should be of little use to Xiao Cun.
But it seemed to be very important to demons. It was kept close to the body by the rabbit demon and sealed with a gold thread bag. It looked very precious.
There is also a booklet called "The Great Demon Kung Fu". The name is very ordinary, and it contains some secret cultivation methods of demons.
Zhang Chu is very interested in this technique. He has studied it three times in the past few days.
Zhang Chu felt that the physical strength of several young men in the village had almost reached its limit. If they wanted to become stronger, they needed to embark on the path of cultivation.
"I don't know whether humans can practice the demon clan's skills. It's time to make a decision." Zhang Chu thought in his heart.
On this day, after Tong Qingshan took another bowl of Yaoning Cream, he found Zhang Chu.
"Sir, I feel that my physical strength has reached its limit, and it is no longer useful to take Yaoning Cream anymore." Tong Qingshan said.
Zhang Chu nodded: "I understand. Let's gather everyone together and have a meeting today."
Soon, everyone in the small village gathered in front of the old date tree.
This time, the old village chief was very solemn and took out some of the monkey wine from his collection and dedicated it to the old jujube tree.
Zhang Chu and the old village chief sat in the center together, with the villagers surrounding them.
At this time, the old village chief said: "During this period, both the hunter team and the children have undergone earth-shaking changes."
"It's better to use the demon condensation ointment given by your husband!" someone said hurriedly.
"Yes, thank you sir!"
This is not flattery, but genuine gratitude.
The old village chief nodded slightly: "But this matter must be kept secret. Whether it is the Yaoning Cream or the three big demons, they are rotten in my stomach. No matter who asks, they can't tell."
"Otherwise, outsiders may bring disaster to us."
As soon as the old village chief finished speaking, a young man of fourteen or fifteen years old shouted: "What are you afraid of? If a bad guy comes again, our jujube tree god can beat the enemy to death with a single blow."
A few children nodded excitedly. After seeing the power of the old jujube tree, many children already regarded the old jujube tree as an invincible god and did not take outsiders into their hearts at all.
The old village chief shook his head: "You can't rely on the jujube tree god for everything. In the demon ruins, the guardian god has rules."
"If outsiders kill us, the patron saint cannot do anything without hurting the patron saint."
"This time the Date Tree God took action because the three banshees didn't know the heights of the world and wanted to attack the Date Tree God. But if their sect came to seek revenge, it would be troublesome."
When everyone heard this, they suddenly panicked.
At the same time, everyone thought that when the three banshees entered the village, even though their language was quite offensive, the Date Tree God did not take the initiative to attack.
In other words, in the fight between villagers and demons, the Zao Tree God probably won't take action.
At this moment, the old village chief continued to educate: "So, you must remember that these things cannot be told, otherwise, there will be big disaster."
Everyone nodded hastily.
Next, the old village chief looked at Zhang Chu and nodded to Zhang Chu.
Zhang Chu then stood up and said: "If you want to survive better in the Demon Ruins, keeping secrets is ultimately the worst policy. If we have the power to protect ourselves, why do we need to keep secrets?"
At this moment, everyone is quietCome, everyone holds their breath quietly, eyes widened, and excited.
Because Zhang Chu recently looked through those books and couldn't hide it from the villagers.
They had already spread the word privately that Zhang Chu might teach everyone how to practice the exercises.
